levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الاشعري

notes: «محمد بن يحيى العطار، وأحمد بن إدريس جميعا»: both narrate from Muhammad b. al-Hasan with no route of their own, so they are co-transmitters of one level (not two branches)
«بإسناده يرفعه إلى» is the gap (rule 8); Abu Abd Allah is named inside the chain and stays a narrator; Amir al-Mu'minin is named in the words after and is the last link
